title: Commuter Benefits Program
agency_path: City of New York > Payroll Administration

description_text: The term of the renewal shall be 3 years commencing on January 18, 2027 and terminating on January 17, 2030.  The Financial Information Services Agency (FISA) and the New York City Office of Payroll Administration (OPA), hereinafter referred to as FISA-OPA, in accordance with Section  4-04 of the Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, intends to exercise its option to renew the Commuter Benefits Program with Edenred Benefits, LLC. As part of the renewal, the vendor will continue to provide and manage the Commuter Benefits Program for Participating Employees.
